notes.title: New Video and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

It's been a couple of weeks since we released and, to be completely honest, the dust is just about settling now. We took a short break last weekend to recuperate, see family and friends that we've been neglecting for months and to finally have some good nights sleep! We were back at it yesterday so you'll be pleased to know that the pesky bug has been fixed. This means you'll be able to get that last achievement - yay! 😀

We've also been getting all misty eyed looking over all the footage that we captured over the years of working on Doris so thought we'd share in the form of a short summary video which you will find below.

If you liked the game, we'd love it if you could leave a review on Steam. It really helps us out and you'll be helping other players too 👵 🐉

Here's the new video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QC3ERJJJ0gc

We are around on Discord all the time if you want to meet and talk to the devs as well as chat with other Doris 2 fans. 👾 Discord: http://discord.gg/PgvEzqW 🕹️

Thanks for reading this update and for supporting our efforts to launch this game. After a long development it is great to see all of you so excited about continuing Doris' and Norb's adventure in Limbo.

Cheers folks,

Ben

notes.title: Doris 2 is out now on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are so pleased to announce that The Tale of Doris and the Dragon - Episode 2 is finally out now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/632590/The_Tale_of_Doris_and_the_Dragon__Episode_2/

The anticipated adventure The Tale of Doris & the Dragon 2 releases today on Steam with a 10% launch discount for €9.00/$10.80/£8.30 (it will be available for €9.99/$11.99/£9.29 after the discount ends).

To celebrate this special day, we are releasing a new trailer and we will be discounting the Doris & the Dragon Episodes 1 and 2 bundle. You can grab it with a 20% discount for a limited time (note - we're fixing a few issues so this will be available VERY soon). If that's not enough for you, you can also grab the game's OST today.

Also, we will be around on Discord today and tomorrow if you want to meet and talk to the devs as well as chat with other Doris 2 fans. 👾 Discord: http://discord.gg/PgvEzqW

Here's the new launch trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sLY2LRl1yEA

notes.title: Everything you need to know about Doris and the Dragon 2 releasing this week!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

It's almost time for the game to unlock! We are super excited about launching so make sure you throw it on your wishlist if you haven't already:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/632590/The_Tale_of_Doris_and_the_Dragon__Episode_2/

In the meantime, we've been busy putting together some behind the scenes content for those of you who are interested in the wider lore and the characters (new and old) in the Doris series. The cast and crew spent some time reflecting on the development process for this sequel and the journey we have all been on together.

We hope you enjoy watching and we'll be back in a couple of days I expect to post that launch day announcement!!

See you then 👵 🐉 

Ben

notes.title: DORIS AND THE DRAGON 2 LAUNCH DATE + TRAILER DROP
notes.notes:
[quote=Arrogant Pixel] Repost of announcement in 21st December 2019 [/quote]

[h1]DORIS AND THE DRAGON 2 LAUNCH DATE + TRAILER DROP[/h1]

You can now Wishlist the heck out of this game on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/632590/The_Tale_of_Doris_and_the_Dragon__Episode_2/?beta=1]WISHLIST NOW[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/632590/The_Tale_of_Doris_and_the_Dragon__Episode_2/?beta=1

We'd love to know what you think of our project and we read all the comments and feedback we receive! Please do head on over to our community page and let everyone know how excited you are! THE TALE OF DORIS AND THE DRAGON EPISODE 2 will be available soon on Steam!

We have been a quiet on socials for a few months because we’ve been getting our heads down to finish Doris 2, once and for all! For all of you following us on Instagram and Twitter, you should have already seen a few things dropping here and there. We are forever grateful for all of your support and feedback and really pleased to be bringing you some really exciting news today.

[h2]Here’s the new trailer:[/h2]

[previewyoutube=lNPkL_lYWT0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]When is The Tale of Doris and the Dragon Episode 2 coming out?[/h2]
The time has come, friends! We have finished development on The Tale of Doris and the Dragon Episode 2. We are aiming towards a launch in February 2020. Press copies will be ready shortly and we are happy to provide assets to any journalists that want to have a look at Doris 2!If you are a journalist / reviewer / youtuber and would like to request a press copy, please get in contact: jay@arrogantpixel.com

[h2]On behalf of everyone at Arrogant Pixel, Merry Christmas everyone![/h2]
Thank you everyone for taking the time to read this article and supporting our efforts to launch this game; it’s been a long time coming.

Again, make sure you WISHLIST the game so you get all the juicy updates!

Love the AP Team
